description: This Java source file defines the 'ApplicationsStackLayout' class, a custom ViewGroup designed for the Android home screen to layout application icons in stacked regions for recents, favorites, and a button, in both vertical and horizontal orientations.

classes.name: ApplicationsStackLayout
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that arranges application icons in stacked sections (recents, favorites, button) for an Android home screen, supporting vertical and horizontal orientations, with customizable margins and background.

methods.name: ApplicationsStackLayout
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the layout with context.

methods.name: ApplicationsStackLayout
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the layout with context and XML attributes, reading styleable attributes for orientation and margins.

methods.name: initLayout
methods.description: Initializes the layout inflater, inflates the button view, and prepares background drawing.

methods.name: getOrientation
methods.description: Returns the current orientation mode (vertical or horizontal).

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws background rectangles behind recents and favorites areas.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the view's dimensions, enforcing EXACTLY measure mode.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Arranges child views (button, recents, favorites) based on orientation.

methods.name: layoutVertical
methods.description: Positions child views for vertical orientation from bottom to top.

methods.name: layoutHorizontal
methods.description: Positions child views for horizontal orientation from right to left.

methods.name: stackApplications
methods.description: Creates and stacks application icon views from a list, positioning them in the layout.

methods.name: removeAllApplications
methods.description: Removes all application icon views except the button.

methods.name: createApplicationIcon
methods.description: Creates a TextView icon for an application with drawable and click handling.

methods.name: setFavorites
methods.description: Sets the list of favorite applications and requests layout refresh.

methods.name: setRecents
methods.description: Sets the list of recent applications and requests layout refresh.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Handles click events on application icons by launching their intents.
